VIDEO SCRIPT: HADITH ON DRESSING
Grade: Grade 6 · Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Hadith on dressing. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• read the Hadith on Islamic dressing for moral uprightness
• describe the male and female dress code as per the Sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
• practise Islamic manner of dressing as an act of ibadah
• appreciate the Islamic dressing to avoid the wrath of Allah

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• Model 1: read the Hadith on Islamic dressing for moral uprightness
• Model 2: describe the male and female dress code as per the Sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
• Model 3: practise Islamic manner of dressing as an act of ibadah
• Model 4: appreciate the Islamic dressing to avoid the wrath of Allah

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Practise: read the Hadith on Islamic dressing for moral uprightness
• Practise: describe the male and female dress code as per the Sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
• Practise: practise Islamic manner of dressing as an act of ibadah

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for Hadith on dressing.”
